claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: no file of vLLM v0.32.0's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names PYTHONUNBUFFERED, and none does at v0.33.0, the release the recorded InferenceX runs used; the result lists the files the scan read. CPython reads it when the interpreter starts, to write standard output and standard error without a buffer, so a log line reaches the pipe when it is written rather than when the buffer fills. That it changes when bytes are delivered and no scheduling, KV-cache or pricing decision of the engine is a reading of the interpreter's documented behaviour, not something the harness shows. Recorded InferenceX runs state it as an environment variable of the container.
